metadata.source: Ichebo Sceptre Community geographic dataset — Zambia
metadata.correction_notice: This version corrects a prior draft that stated 156 National Assembly constituencies. The Electoral Commission of Zambia (ECZ) delimitation exercise announced 16 April 2026 (effective 15 May 2026, under the Constitution of Zambia (Amendment) Act No. 13 of 2025) added 70 new constituencies, raising the national total to 226 ahead of the 13 August 2026 general election. This dataset reflects the corrected 226-constituency figure.
metadata.verification: Province/District tier verified as before. Constituency tier (226 total) verified against elections.org.zm (ECZ home page summary statistics), elections.org.zm/?p=5529 (ECZ announcement), parliament.gov.zm/node/13025 (National Assembly announcement with per-province totals), and parliament.gov.zm/members/constituencies (National Assembly's full constituency-by-province name listing), all checked 2026-08-19. Cross-referenced against lgazambia.org.zm's Central Province page for district-tier corroboration.
metadata.pattern_note: Zambia's local-government/electoral pattern is Province -> District -> Constituency -> Ward. Constituency does not nest cleanly 1:1 under District administratively — ECZ constituency boundaries can span or subdivide districts. The constituency list here is grouped at PROVINCE level per the official parliament.gov.zm structure; an explicit constituency-to-district assignment is not asserted and would need ECZ delimitation gazettes if required at that precision.
metadata.constituency_tier_note: 226 constituencies nationally (up from 156), all named and listed per province below. Entries marked created_in_2026_delimitation: true are among the 70 new constituencies created in the April 2026 ECZ delimitation.
metadata.ward_tier_note: Ward tier remains a structural placeholder (count: null). ECZ's official published national total is 1,858 wards; per-constituency ward counts and boundaries require ECZ ward-delimitation gazette lookups, pending.
